title: Televised remote viewing by Japanese schoolchildren: starfish target

tellings.quote: school school rooms what the target was was a small aquarium with the starfish

plain: Schoolchildren in classrooms in Tokyo, Hokkaido and Kyushu in Japan took part in a televised test of remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe a hidden or faraway target using only the mind. The remote viewer Joe McMoneagle, who says he was part of it, recalls that the target was a small aquarium with a starfish in it. If true, it would suggest ordinary children could do this on camera.
